causal_guarantees: every feature is computed only from bars closed strictly before decision_at
the same-time relative-volume baseline uses only prior-session history that ends before today's open
the daily context (ATR, EMA20, 20-day high, 20-day median turnover) uses only sessions strictly before today's session date
cross-sectional statistics exclude the candidate's own code from its peer distribution
future bars, future peer bars, and rows after the frozen exit window cannot change an already-computed feature vector
not_yet_implemented: the Precision Ladder selector, calibration, thresholding and abstention (Milestone 3 - since implemented, see evidence/aem-v2-precision-ladder.json)
any accuracy, availability or economics result (Milestone 4)
corrections: Milestone 4's real-data run surfaced a tz-backend mismatch (zoneinfo vs pytz, both legitimately 'Asia/Kolkata') that made pandas silently degrade a concatenated index to object dtype inside the tod_rvol computation, crashing on real staged data though every synthetic test fixture (built with one consistent backend) had passed. Fixed by normalizing intraday_history onto the same tz object as the signal bars before concatenating. No feature formula, contract or test assertion changed; implementation_sha256 above reflects the fixed file.

decision.reason: Milestone 2 is now complete: the causal feature registry, the universe integrity audit and the frozen development dataset all exist (see evidence/aem-v2-universe-audit.json for the audit result: 5,999/6,000 symbol-sessions included on the frozen 50-stock cohort). No selector has been fit on this data and no accuracy result exists. The canonical AEM v1 baseline (149/693 = 21.50% strict success, 18.60% Wilson lower bound, -0.27471R mean net R) is unchanged.
